Prometheus-compatible HTTP metrics middleware. Tracks request counts and latency by method, path pattern, and status code.

Create an HTTP handler that serves the /metrics endpoint in Prometheus format.

Typically registered as: router.get("/metrics", collector.metricsHandler())

proc metricsMiddleware(collector: MetricsCollector): Middleware {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}

Create a middleware that records request count and latency metrics.

The middleware measures the time taken by downstream handlers and records the method, path, and status code for each request.
